description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It initializes the React app, attaches it to the DOM element with id 'root', and renders the top-level <App /> component wrapped in React.StrictMode for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root to render the React application into the DOM element with the specified HTMLElement.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element tree within the root created by ReactDOM.createRoot.
